title: Machinist's Bench
note: Turns iron into the parts every other trade fits: fasteners, brackets, hoops, springs and gear sets. Precision parts are turned by hand to a drawing first; from the Drill Press on, the bench keeps the setup as a jig and repeats it. A drill press and a lathe open finer work.

recipes.title: Fasteners
recipes.note: Six nuggets turned into eight bolts, nuts and rivets.

recipes.title: Steel brackets
recipes.note: Two ingots bent and drilled into three brackets.

recipes.title: Barrel hoops
recipes.note: Two ingots drawn into four hoops: a Vintner's vat and cask need them.

recipes.title: Coil springs
recipes.note: An ingot wound and tempered into four springs.

recipes.title: Bearing set
recipes.note: Four nuggets rolled into balls and races, with a spring for the cage: two bearing sets. A worn bearing in a machine is replaced with one.

recipes.title: Drive shaft
recipes.note: A stepped shaft turned to a drawing. Turned by hand at a Vice and Files; a Drill Press runs it from the jig you set. Gearboxes and pumps are built on one.

recipes.title: Gear set
recipes.note: Two iron and two copper cut into a gear set. The top tier of most stations needs one.

recipes.title: Gearbox
recipes.note: Two gear sets on a turned shaft and a bearing, bolted into a case. It keeps the grade of the shaft it was built on. A Mill's Geared Crank takes one.

recipes.title: Machined parts
recipes.note: Alloy and iron turned to a drawing: turned by hand the first time, then run from the bench's jig. The Gunsmith's parts kits are built around them.

recipes.title: Precision machinery parts
recipes.note: Lathe work to tight tolerances, turned by hand to a long drawing, then from a jig.

recipes.title: Pump assembly
recipes.note: A gearbox driving an impeller on its own shaft. The heart of an Irrigation Sprinkler and of the cities' waterworks.

recipes.title: Unstamped plate
recipes.note: Plate that appears on no register. Restricted components at a checkpoint.
